# Published release files, frozen

Exact copies of published `band-coach.html` release assets, kept so an upgrade test can open the old
app, build a real profile with it, then open the new file over that same profile, with no network.
Do not edit or regenerate these; each one is checked against the sha256 GitHub lists for the asset.

- `v1.9.0/band-coach.html`: `gh release download v1.9.0 --repo Back-Road-Creative/band-coach --pattern band-coach.html`,
  sha256 `05d267982c3ed7140fb862280cfa21c44c6ac0ae630ea9615d1a54f4171a085b`, 483093 bytes.
